title: Red candies · photo
description: Detect the four red candies. Ignore orange, green, blue, and brown candies.
context: A simple photograph with a white background. Measure the visible length, width, and mean color. Do not count clipped candies at the image edge.

strategies.name: Red hue + contours
strategies.rationale: Red wraps around the HSV hue boundary. A circularity filter removes thin color artifacts.

strategies.name: Dark foreground
strategies.rationale: A grayscale baseline may find candies, but cannot reliably separate red from other dark colors.

strategies.name: Edge contours
strategies.rationale: A shape-only baseline should reveal boundaries but may also include other colors.

title: Green shapes · 2D
description: Detect both solid green 2D shapes, including the portions touching the image boundary.
context: Flat graphic with transparency, composited on white. Shapes are clipped by the frame: report visible extents only, not the full physical object size.

strategies.name: Green hue mask
strategies.rationale: The flat green fill separates cleanly from the white background. Keep contours touching the frame.

strategies.name: Grayscale silhouette
strategies.rationale: A second way to isolate the darker shapes against a white background.

strategies.name: Adaptive silhouette
strategies.rationale: Local thresholding is useful under uneven illumination, but may leave only thin rims on a flat graphic.

title: Coins · photo
credit: Brooklyn Museum / scikit-image · no known copyright restrictions
description: Detect all 24 separate coins on the gray background.
context: Grayscale photo with uneven brightness and textured coins. A harder comparison for simple thresholding. Shapes are roughly circular.

strategies.name: Coin edge contours
strategies.rationale: Closed coin boundaries can separate objects even when coin and background intensities overlap.

strategies.name: Bright coins
strategies.rationale: Global thresholding is a fast baseline but may merge coins into the bright background.

strategies.name: Local bright coins
strategies.rationale: A local threshold compensates for some background brightness variation.
